answer: Bind each identity to a TEE key burned into the chip. Verify the quote on every submission. Convert the reward into a stream that vests over 40 epochs. Slash the unvested remainder when a quote fails. Then watch the incentive: a rented chip farm pays rent monthly while the stream drips, so a comet of fake identities must survive forty epochs before it turns a profit. A velvet front of early rewards hides that cost. The knoll to hold is slow vesting, the tax on hardware you cannot fake twice.
